decisions.reason: The certified HVAC plate exchangers sit close to the core offer, and 2022 HVAC and heat-pump demand is strong, so the line likely meets aspirations even though it was not seen on the website in 2020 and 2021.
The box cooler line has a claimed major market share in water cooling and builds on core marine competence, so it shows no shortfall that would trigger search, despite lower recent visibility.

The marine cooling unit complements the box cooler line, but it has been missing from the website since 2020 and the marine market is weak, which raises the risk of consolidation; slack from a growing, hiring firm still allows it to be carried.
The compact oil cooler line has had low visibility and no reported results, making it a candidate for portfolio pruning, but there is no clear evidence of a shortfall against aspiration yet.
The finned tube is a component that supports the core air cooler business, so dropping it would release few resources even though it was not observed recently.
